content.short: USP Blockchain Club supports USP Polytechnic's leading blockchain community, empowering future tech leaders to innovate and shape Web3.
content.description: USP Blockchain Club helps students and professionals bridge the gap between theoretical blockchain concepts and real-world applications. The club achieves this through hands-on workshops, mentorship from industry experts, and collaborative projects that provide practical experience in blockchain development and deployment. Beginners follow a structured learning path via study groups, while advanced members work on real-world projects in partnership with corporate partners. Participants gain exposure to project lifecycles from planning to delivery and build portfolios that showcase usable blockchain skills.
content.meta: USP Blockchain Club offers hands-on workshops, mentorship, and projects. Discover USP Blockchain Club and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
